chapters.voice: For autonomous execution, choose an Autopilot market and strategy, then review your capital, exposure, and risk limits. Your wallet funds the vault and authorizes the policy. Gateway funds the entry pass. Autopilot monitors the setup and acts only when its required rules pass. You can follow the vault, pause entries, and manage capital from its controls. Open the strategy journal to see holds, checks, recovery events, and confirmed actions. A hold is a decision, too. Running does not mean a new trade has occurred.
